body.name: Tagged-polynomial risk reconstruction
body.construction: Put \(p_{\ell i}(r)=[z^r]F_{\ell,\{i\}}(z)\), \(p_{\ell ij}(r)=[z^r]F_{\ell,\{i,j\}}(z)\), \(\rho_{\ell i}=\sum_{r=2}^np_{\ell i}(r)/r\), and \(m_{\ell}=(\rho_{\ell}^{\mathsf T},-\rho_{\ell}^{\mathsf T})^{\mathsf T}\). Define \(M_{\ell}^{11}(i,i)=\sum_rp_{\ell i}(r)/(r t(r))\), \(M_{\ell}^{00}(i,i)=\sum_rp_{\ell i}(r)/(r c(r))\), and, for \(i\ne j\), \(M_{\ell}^{11}(i,j)=\sum_rp_{\ell ij}(r)(t(r)-1)/(t(r)r(r-1))\), \(M_{\ell}^{00}(i,j)=\sum_rp_{\ell ij}(r)(c(r)-1)/(c(r)r(r-1))\), \(M_{\ell}^{10}(i,j)=-\sum_rp_{\ell ij}(r)/(r(r-1))\), with \(M_{\ell}^{10}(i,i)=0\) and \(M_{\ell}^{01}=(M_{\ell}^{10})^{\mathsf T}\). Set \(M_{\ell}=\begin{psmallmatrix}M_{\ell}^{11}&M_{\ell}^{10}\\M_{\ell}^{01}&M_{\ell}^{00}\end{psmallmatrix}\) and \(Q_{\ell}=M_{\ell}-m_{\ell}d^{\mathsf T}-dm_{\ell}^{\mathsf T}+dd^{\mathsf T}\).
